AC1: "Before `keryx wiki enrich`, `keryx wiki collect`, `keryx wiki sync --apply`, or the wiki-writing step of `keryx update` overwrites or deletes a page whose content changes, the page's exact prior bytes are saved as the next `vNNNN-<timestamp>.md` in `.metaproject/data/gdwiki/history/<page-path>/`, and that folder's `index.md` gains a row (version, UTC time, command, run id, sha256, link) and marks the current version; a test per command proves the saved file is byte-identical to the pre-run page. Nothing is archived (no tar/zip); no version files are written inside `.metaproject/wiki/`." -> "Before `keryx wiki enrich`, `keryx wiki collect` (incl. `--force`/`--changed`), `keryx sync --apply` (collect + orphan prune), `keryx wiki new --force`, `keryx wiki refresh`, `keryx wiki verify`, `keryx wiki migrate-markers`, or the SAC wiki owner-writer overwrites or deletes a page whose content changes, the page's exact prior bytes are saved as the next `vNNNN-<timestamp>.md` in `.metaproject/data/gdwiki/history/<page-path>/`, and that folder's `index.md` gains a row (version, UTC time, command, run id, sha256, link) and marks the current version; a test per writer proves the saved file is byte-identical to the pre-run page. Nothing is archived (no tar/zip); no version files are written inside `.metaproject/wiki/`. `index.md`, `.sections.json` and create-if-missing templates are not pages and are excluded, as documented." (T1 found the frozen AC1 named a non-existent command (keryx wiki sync --apply; the real one is keryx sync --apply) and a keryx update page write that does not exist; it also missed wiki new --force, refresh, verify, migrate-markers and the SAC owner-writer)
